name: Parkinson's telemonitoring (42 patients)
citation: Tsanas A, Little MA, McSharry PE, Ramig LO. Accurate telemonitoring of Parkinson's disease progression by non-invasive speech tests. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2010;57(4):884-93.

random.label: Random rows
random.description: Random rows: KFold(5, shuffle=True), ignoring patient ID

temporal.label: Track known patients
temporal.description: Known patients, later visits: each patient's recordings in time order; train on earlier visits, test on the next block

group.label: Screen new patients
group.description: New patients: GroupKFold(5) by patient ID
